The '''2014 Copa del Rey final''' was the 112th final of [[Copa del Rey|Spain's premier football cup]] since its establishment (including two seasons where two rival editions were played). The match was an ''[[El Clásico]]'' between [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] and [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] on 15 April 2014 at [[Mestalla Stadium|Mestalla]] in [[Valencia]],<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.rfef.es/index.jsp?nodo=8&ID=3940 |title=La RFEF acogió la reunión entre los finalistas de la Copa de SM el Rey |language=es |publisher=[[Royal Spanish Football Federation]] |date=20 February 2014 |access-date=20 February 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140226012029/http://www.rfef.es/index.jsp?nodo=8&ID=3940 |archive-date=2014-02-26 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url = https://www.bbc.com/sport/0/football/27039496|title=Cristiano Ronaldo out of Real Madrid v Barcelona tie|date=15 April 2014|work=BBC Sport|access-date=16 April 2014}}</ref> making it the seventh such Copa del Rey final ([[2011 Copa del Rey final|the most recent]] was also played at the Mestalla on 20 April 2011).

Real Madrid won the cup for the 19th time after a 2&ndash;1 win.<ref>{{cite web|url = https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/football/teams/barcelona/10769545/Real-Madrid-vs-Barcelona-Copa-del-Rey-final-2014-live.html|title=Barcelona 1-2 Real Madrid Live|date=16 April 2014|work=Daily Telegraph|access-date=17 April 2014}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url = https://www.bbc.com/sport/0/football/27053737|title=Barcelona 1-2 Real Madrid |date=16 April 2014|work=BBC Sport|access-date=17 April 2014}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.goal.com/en-gb/match/130950/barcelona-vs-real-madrid/report|title=Brilliant Bale breakaway heaps more misery on Martino's men|date=16 April 2014|work=Goal.com|access-date=17 April 2014|archive-date=19 April 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140419031930/http://www.goal.com/en-gb/match/130950/barcelona-vs-real-madrid/report|url-status=dead}}</ref> In winning the final, Real Madrid went on to play against  [[Atlético Madrid]], the winners of the [[2013&ndash;14 La Liga]] season, in the [[2014 Supercopa de España]].

==Build-up==
The match was rescheduled to be played three days earlier than the original date as there was a chance that both clubs could have [[UEFA Champions League]] semi-finals the following week. Each team was allotted 20,000 tickets for club members.<ref>{{cite web|url = http://sportsillustrated.cnn.com/soccer/news/20140220/barcelona-real-madrid-copa-del-rey-final-spain-date.ap/|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20140305070309/http://sportsillustrated.cnn.com/soccer/news/20140220/barcelona-real-madrid-copa-del-rey-final-spain-date.ap/|url-status = dead|archive-date = March 5, 2014|title=Barcelona vs. Real Madrid Copa del Rey final rescheduled|date=10 April 2014|work=Sports Illustrated |access-date=16 April 2014}}</ref>
Real Madrid's top scorer of the season [[Cristiano Ronaldo]] missed the final due to knee and thigh injuries.<ref>{{cite web|url = http://espnfc.com/news/story/_/id/1786396/real-madrid-star-cristiano-ronaldo-ruled-copa-del-rey-final-barcelona?cc=5739|title=Cristiano Ronaldo ruled out of cup final|date=10 April 2014|work=ESPN|access-date=16 April 2014}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url = https://www.theguardian.com/football/2014/apr/15/cristiano-ronaldo-injury-copa-del-rey-real-madrid-barcelona|title=Cristiano Ronaldo to miss Copa del Rey final against Barcelona with injury|date=15 April 2014|work=Guardian |access-date=16 April 2014}}</ref>

Real Madrid were appearing in their 39th Copa del Rey Final, with a prior tally of 18 victories, while Barcelona had won 26 of their 35 finals. The two teams had each won three of the six previous ''El Clásico'' finals: Real Madrid in 1936, [[1974 Copa del Generalísimo|1974]] and [[2011 Copa del Rey final|2011]], Barcelona in [[1968 Copa del Generalísimo|1968]], [[1983 Copa del Rey Final|1983]] and [[1990 Copa del Rey final|1990]]. The 2011 win was Real Madrid's most recent, having been defeated in the [[2013 Copa del Rey final|2013 final]]. Barcelona had last won the cup in [[2012 Copa del Rey final|2012]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Spain - List of Cup Finals|website=[[RSSSF]]|url=https://www.rsssf.org/tabless/spancuphist.html|access-date=18 April 2014}}</ref>

==Match==
===Summary===
{{external media
| float  = right
| width  = 20em
| video1 = {{YouTube|id=yWVrolNQ4RU&t|title=Gareth Bale's incredible goal against Barcelona {{!}} Copa del Rey Final 2014}}
}}
After 11 minutes Real Madrid went in front when [[Ángel Di María]]'s low left footed shot from the left went through [[Jordi Alba]]'s legs and in off goalkeeper [[José Manuel Pinto]]'s left hand. Barcelona were level in the 68th minute when [[Marc Bartra]] headed into the far corner of the net after a [[Xavi (footballer, born 1980)|Xavi]] corner from the left.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Lowe |first1=Sid |title=Real Madrid's Gareth Bale gallops past Barcelona to land Copa del Rey |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2014/apr/16/barcelona-real-madrid-copa-del-rey-match-report-gareth-bale |access-date=17 September 2020 |work=The Guardian |date=16 April 2014}}</ref>

The winning goal came with five minutes to go when [[Gareth Bale]] picked the ball up just inside his own half on the left wing and went past Bartra at a blistering pace (at one point off the field before running back onto the field) leaving Bartra in his wake, before running into the penalty area, evading more challenges and then composedly slotting the ball left-footed low past the goalkeeper from six yards out.
Some football [[pundit]]s labelled his goal as a masterclass,<ref>{{cite web|url = https://www.theguardian.com/football/2014/apr/16/barcelona-real-madrid-copa-del-rey-match-report-gareth-bale|title=Real Madrid's Gareth Bale gallops past Barcelona to land Copa del Rey|date=16 April 2014|work=Guardian |access-date=17 April 2014}}</ref> whilst Barcelona coach [[Gerardo Martino]] admitted that it was "difficult to see a player sprint like that at that stage of the game".<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/0/football/27059882|title=Gareth Bale: Copa del Rey winner incredible, says Xabi Alonso|date=16 April 2014|work=BBC Sport|quote=Barcelona boss Gerardo Martino said: "It is difficult to see a player sprint like that at that stage of the game."|access-date=28 April 2017}}</ref>
